notes: represents 5: Grey zigzag bar with red bits below; following a curve isn't clear. -> Show a smooth red S spline with a segmented grey body lying along it.

legibility 5: At 1x a broken squiggle. -> Larger, smoother shapes.
craft 6: Fragmented red pieces. -> Make the red curve one continuous stroke.
represents 5: Slab with faint lines and a dashed red line; dissolve not obvious. -> Quad grid on top with one red dotted fading edge between two merged faces.

legibility 4: At 1x the lines vanish. -> Higher-contrast grid edges, bigger slab.
craft 6: Muddy faint lines. -> Crisp dark edge lines.

craft 6: Off-palette cream for mesh category. -> Use mesh grey.

legibility 5: At 1x a jumble of blue, yellow and red bits. -> Fewer, larger parts: three thick arrows.
craft 6: Cluttered, mixed colours. -> Drop the yellow ball and joystick knob.
represents 5: Cube on a dark tray with cream squares and a red ball; unclear. -> Cube above a red heat glow with output texture map tiles beside it.

legibility 5: Small parts at 1x. -> Larger elements.
craft 6: Cluttered. -> Simplify to two parts.

craft 7: Clean. -> Remove the button look.

craft 6: Clean but odd. -> Align along the slider axis.
represents 5: Grey block with red upper band; taper barely visible. -> Exaggerate the wall taper into a clear frustum, add a red angle arc and a vertical pull arrow.

legibility 6: At 1x it's a red-and-grey cube. -> Make the slanted walls red only, top grey.
craft 7: Clean; stray red pixel near bottom. -> Remove stray red pixel.
represents 6: Grey rock on a dark rod with yellow knob and pink ball; slider idea weak. -> Horizontal slider track with knob mid-way, cube at left end, sphere at right end.
distinct 5: Same dark rod as Key end. -> Make Shape key show the full track; Key end only the end stop.

craft 6: Diagonal composition scattered. -> Straight horizontal layout.
represents 6: Cube, red ball and file card; no outward direction. -> Add a red arrow leaving the cube into the file.

legibility 6: File card small at 1x. -> Larger file card.
craft 7: Clean. -> Replace red ball with the arrow.
represents 6: Small grey bent tube with a thin red path tail. -> Add a red ring profile at the start and a longer curved red rail the tube follows.

legibility 4: At 1x it's a tiny grey squiggle, much smaller than neighbours. -> Scale up to fill the cell; thicken the red path.
craft 6: Underfilled frame, thin trailing line. -> Reframe to fill the cell.
represents 5: Grey dome on a cream ring with red tick; reads as a hat. -> A knob dial with tick marks around and a red pointer.
distinct 7: Different from Remove/Remedy. -> Keep dial concept.
legibility 6: Red tick small at 1x. -> Larger red pointer line.
craft 6: Hat-like brim. -> Replace brim with a tick-marked plate.
represents 5: Cream block resting on a red slab; no visible cut. -> Grey body sliced by a red plane, with the cut-off half lifted away and faded.

legibility 6: At 1x reads as a sandwich/cake. -> Show a clear gap between kept and removed halves.
craft 6: Red slab edges are ragged. -> Clean the plane edges into a crisp rectangle.

represents 6: Three separate grey spheres clustered with a tiny red seam; they touch but don't visibly melt into one body. -> Fuse the spheres with smooth thick necks/webbing so it reads as one organic mass; recolour to clay/flesh tone.

craft 8: Clean outline and shading, well framed. -> Remove the dark interior outline between spheres so the merge reads continuous.
represents 7: File card, red ball, grey cube: something from a file to a cube, but no direction. -> Add a red arrow pointing from the file into the cube.

legibility 6: At 1x the file card is a small beige smudge. -> Enlarge the file card and give it a clear folded corner.
craft 7: Clean but cluttered three-object composition. -> Replace the red ball with the arrow to reduce parts.

represents 6: Red disc on top of a grey square slab with a waist between; blend is unclear. -> Show square section at bottom, circle at top, both outlined red, with a smooth grey transition solid between.

legibility 6: At 1x it's a red blob over a slab. -> Make the two sections larger and the neck readable.
craft 7: Clean. -> Tighten framing.

craft 6: Blobby shape. -> Define segments.

legibility 7: Readable at 1x. -> Keep strong red.
craft 7: Clean. -> Tighten outline.

craft 7: Clean. -> Fill frame.

legibility 7: Red edge reads at 1x. -> Make facet lines contrasting.
craft 8: Clean. -> Remove stray dots on faces.

legibility 7: Red outline is visible at 1x but very narrow and tall. -> Tilt to isometric and widen the shape so it fills the cell.

legibility 6: Upright card is narrow at 1x; flap hard to see. -> Tilt to iso like the other cloth icons and enlarge the flap.
craft 7: Clean. -> Thicker stitch line.

distinct 7: Distinct; blue colour odd for check. -> Keep shape.
